segments.title: New PokemonPage, TrainerPicker, usePokemon and fetchPokemon, modified App component

traceDiagram.title: Pokemon page flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the app mounts `App`, which renders the Pokemon page and loads its Pokemon through `usePokemon()`. It also shows what happens when the user clicks Pokemon or picks a trainer, and how the trainer id reaches the API through `fetchPokemon()`.

traceNodes.label: Renders the header and the page the user chose
traceNodes.description: When the browser loads the page, [`createApp()` makes this component the root of the app](code:src/main.ts#L4), and [`app.mount("#app")` renders it](code:src/main.ts#L6).

children.label: Lists the Pokemon of the picked trainer
children.description: When a user clicks Pokemon, [App sets `page` to `"pokemon"`](code:src/App.vue#L17) and [renders this page](code:src/App.vue#L23).

children.label: Shows the trainers in a select
children.description: When PokemonPage renders, [it renders this component](code:src/views/pokemon/PokemonPage.vue#L20) with the trainers and the id of the picked trainer.

traceNodes.label: Loads the Pokemon each time the trainer id changes
traceNodes.description: When PokemonPage renders, [it calls this composable](code:src/views/pokemon/PokemonPage.vue#L9) with its `trainerId` ref. When a user picks a trainer, [`selectTrainer()` writes `trainerId`](code:src/views/pokemon/PokemonPage.vue#L13), and the watch of this composable runs again.

traceNodes.label: Creates the app with App as its root component
traceNodes.description: When the browser loads the page, [`app.mount("#app")` mounts this app](code:src/main.ts#L6).

blockLabels.label: Takes App as the root component

traceNodes.label: Requests the Pokemon of one trainer or of every trainer
traceNodes.description: When PokemonPage opens or a user picks a trainer, [the watch of `usePokemon()` calls this function](code:src/composables/use-pokemon.ts#L12) with the trainer id.

blockLabels.label: Returns the Pokemon from the API
Calls request to get the Pokemon, filtered by the trainer when one is given

traceNodes.label: Sets the open page to the Pokemon page
traceNodes.description: When a user clicks the Pokemon button of the header, this handler sets `page` to `"pokemon"`, and [App renders `<PokemonPage />`](code:src/App.vue#L23).

traceNodes.label: Stores the trainer id the picker emits
traceNodes.description: When a user picks a trainer, [TrainerPicker emits `select`](code:src/views/pokemon/components/TrainerPicker.vue#L8) with the trainer id, and Vue calls [`selectTrainer()`](code:src/views/pokemon/PokemonPage.vue#L12-14). The new value of `trainerId` makes [the watch of `usePokemon()`](code:src/composables/use-pokemon.ts#L8-16) load the Pokemon again.

traceNodes.label: Emits select with the picked trainer id
traceNodes.description: When a user picks an option of the select, Vue runs this `change` handler with the value of the option.

traceNodes.label: Computes the highest level again when the Pokemon change
traceNodes.description: When `PokemonPage` renders, Vue runs [this computed](code:src/views/pokemon/PokemonPage.vue#L10) the first time `highestLevel` is read, and again after `pokemon` changes.
